areas.decision: Reuse compact procedural item sprites, shared grade borders, slot names, quantities and unknown-quality marks. Keep hidden identities hidden; do not replace small interactive cells with painted frames.
Reuse approved relic paintings in the larger detail/codex presentation. Retain small named sprite fallback, text and keyboard/touch enlargement.
Reuse existing bestiary paintings and shared panels. Preserve discovery silhouettes, statistics, collection disclosures and text; do not expose undiscovered creatures through decoration.
Reuse item sprites and shared item detail/relic presentation. Keep names, prices, comparisons and confirmation controls as text, separate from art.
Retain scalable 24-unit line icons and labelled condition buttons, warning ! and benefit + cues, accessible names and 44px minimum status targets. No painted status icon atlas.

source_snapshot: Pre-integration Batch V audit; runtime delivery later adds smooth sampling for painted encounter images without changing frames or controls.
